task.description:
Produce a code design artefact at src/design/sch06-timer-jitter.md for requirement SCH-06 (Timer jitter). SCH-06 adds a configurable random jitter (±N ms) to the scheduler polling interval to prevent thundering-herd effects in clustered deployments. The design must cover:

1. New config field `BPM_SCHEDULER_JITTER_MS` (default 0 = disabled)
2. Random jitter calculation: `actual_delay = base_interval ± random(0, jitter_ms)` applied to the poll cycle sleep
3. Thread-local random state (independent per node, no shared seed)
4. Jitter MUST NOT be applied to timer's fire_at; only to polling interval
5. Edge case: jitter larger than base interval — minimum effective interval is 0
6. The module to modify is src/scheduler/scheduler.zig (same boundary as SCH-05)
7. No DB schema changes needed
8. Read existing src/design/scheduler.md and src/design/sch05-missed-timer-recovery.md for context on the scheduler architecture
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion from SCH-06 maps to a concrete design element
Config interface defined (env var name, type, validation)
Random number source specified (thread-local, no shared seed)
Jitter application point identified in the polling loop

result.summary: Design artefact for SCH-06 (Timer jitter): config interface, thread-local PRNG, jitter calculation formula with ±random(0,jitter_ms), application point in poll-cycle sleep, edge-case clamping for jitter > base interval, and five open questions documented.
